Kids Bible Class

Our Church Family Story

Community Church — Ashburn, Virginia (1982–today)
Who grows God's family?

“Love each other as I have loved you.”

John 15:12 (NIrV)

God grows His family!

Image 1

In 1982, God planted a tiny seed in Northern Virginia.

A small group of friends who loved Jesus started a church family — first in a school, and even under a tent!

It was little… but Jesus was with them. God grows His family!

Image 2

Today that family loves the next generation!

In Community Kids (CKids), little ones learn that Jesus loves them.

Fire Escape (FE) helps middle and high school students follow Jesus with their friends.

Image 3

The church also grows kids through Virginia Academy — a school right on the campus.

Students learn with faith, kindness, and purpose.

God's family helps children grow strong in every part of life!

Image 4

Community Church loves our local neighbors too!

Volunteers pack food and share meals with families who need help.

When we feed people and care for them, we love them the way Jesus loves us.

Image 5

Friends grow closer in Connect Groups — small groups where people pray and share life.

And God's family loves the whole world — helping partners in places far away.

From a tiny seed to a big loving church: God grows His family!

Image 6

Our pastors love Jesus and love people.

They help our church family grow — teaching, caring, and cheering us on.

Together with everyone who serves, we love people the same way God loves us. You belong here!

What We Learn

Community Church began as a tiny group of friends who loved Jesus — meeting in a school and even a tent. God grew that seed into a big church family in Ashburn with CKids, Fire Escape, Virginia Academy, food outreach, Connect Groups, and love for neighbors near and far. Pastors and people serve together so everyone can know Jesus.

For you: You are part of this story. When you love others, serve, invite friends, and follow Jesus, God grows His family!
